description: Source code for the 'scrollpane' widget in the Wesnoth game's GUI, managing scrollable content areas.

classes.name: widget_finder
classes.description: Helper class to find a widget in the scrollpane content.

classes.name: scrollpane
classes.description: A GUI widget providing a scrollable area containing other widgets.

methods.name: scrollpane::scrollpane
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scrollpane with a video context.

methods.name: scrollpane::clear
methods.description: Clears all content widgets from the scrollpane.

methods.name: scrollpane::set_location
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the scrollpane.

methods.name: scrollpane::hide
methods.description: Hides or shows all widgets within the scrollpane.

methods.name: scrollpane::add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the scrollpane at specified position and z-order.

methods.name: scrollpane::remove_widget
methods.description: Removes a widget from the scrollpane.

methods.name: scrollpane::set_inner_location
methods.description: Sets the clip rectangle for all inner widgets.

methods.name: scrollpane::scroll
methods.description: Scrolls the content to a specified vertical position.

methods.name: scrollpane::update_widget_positions
methods.description: Updates positions of all inner widgets based on scroll position.

methods.name: scrollpane::position_widget
methods.description: Positions a specific widget within the scrollpane.

methods.name: scrollpane::client_area
methods.description: Returns the drawable client area of the scrollpane.

methods.name: scrollpane::update_content_size
methods.description: Recalculates the total size of the content area.
